summary: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 disclosing a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with Bluechip Co. Holdings. The transaction is structured as two sequential mergers: Flag Ship merges into a wholly owned subsidiary, becoming the publicly traded parent, then a merger subsidiary absorbs Bluechip. Flag Ship ordinary shares convert one-for-one into Purchaser shares, while rights exchange for one-tenth shares. The filing does not disclose purchase price, premium, or close timeline, leaving valuation and deal terms ambiguous for arbitrageurs.
